Thanks again for the call earlier — good alignment on goals and success criteria. Per our discussion attached is the updated Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft with the load/perf test milestone fleshed out. Key items for that milestone:

- Target window: week of Sep 20 (flexible) — please confirm windows that work for you.
- Peak QPS target: 1,200 concurrent QPS (based on your traffic sample).
- Redwood responsibility: provision dedicated capacity (GPUs), run replay, capture latency/95/99, and provide configuration recommendations.
- FinServ responsibility: provide sanitized traffic replay file (CSV), test account credentials, and an internal observer for validation.
- Dependencies: signed SOW for dedicated capacity + access to traffic samples + procurement clearance for test window.
- Target milestone completion / close: Sep 30, 2026 (MAP-level target)

Ask: can you confirm the sample traffic file and whether you have any blackout windows the week of Sep 20? Also flag if procurement needs a formal test statement for approvals.

I've attached the MAP draft (PDF) and included a short sample traffic schema file (CSV) if helpful.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm availability & share sanitized traffic sample by Mon Sep 13.
2) Redwood schedules load test & shares runbook for sign-off by Sep 15.
3) Execute replay during confirmed window; Redwood to deliver results + sizing recommendation within 48 hours post-run.

Thanks — I’ll follow up if I don't hear back by EOD Mon.
